selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of a tender nodule on her forehead with granulomatous inflammation and narrow-budding yeasts with thick capsules on skin biopsy, along with a tissue culture growing Cryptococcus neoformans, strongly supports Primary cutaneous cryptococcosis (PCC) as the most specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Immunodeficiency-related infection
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence linking the infection to an immunodeficiency condition beyond the patient's multiple sclerosis treatment with fingolimod

rejected.label: Fingolimod-related infection
rejected.why: While fingolimod can increase the risk of infections, the specific evidence pointing to Cryptococcus neoformans infection is more directly aligned with Primary cutaneous cryptococcosis (PCC)
